name: Wall of Living Fire
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: magus 6, sorcerer/wizard 6, summoner 6

Components: V, S, M (a small piece of phosphorus)

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Effect: Opaque sheet of flame up to 20 ft. long/level or a ring of fire with a radius of up to 5 ft. per two levels; either form 20 ft. high

Duration: Concentration + 1 round/level

Saving Throw: None; Spell Resistance: yes

This spell is identical to wall of fire, but the caster can change the location, orientation and form of the wall once per round, up to a maximum of three times per casting of the spell. The caster must concentrate to change the wall.
